ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$, a square ABDE is constructed externally on the hypotenuse AB of the triangle, and the diagonals of the square meet at point $O$. Line OC is connected. Given that $AC=3$ and $OC=4\sqrt{2}$, what is the length of BC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw line OF $\perp$ BC at F, and draw line AM $\perp$ OF at M,\\
$\because$ $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AMO=\angle OFB=90^\circ$, $\angle ACB=\angle CFM=\angle AMF=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral ACFM is a rectangle,\\
$\therefore$ AM=CF, AC=MF=3,\\
$\because$ Quadrilateral ABDE is a square,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, OA=OB,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOM+\angle BOF=90^\circ$,\\
Also $\because$ $\angle AMO=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOM+\angle OAM=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOF=\angle OAM$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AOM \cong \triangle OBF$ (AAS),\\
$\therefore$ AM=OF, OM=FB,\\
$\therefore$ OF=CF,\\
$\because$ $\angle CFO=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle CFO$ is an isosceles right-angle triangle,\\
$\because$ OC=$4\sqrt{2}$,\\
By the Pythagorean theorem: CF=OF=4,\\
$\therefore$ BF=OF-MF=4-3=1,\\
$\therefore$ BC=CF+BF=4+1=\boxed{5}.

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中，ABC 是一个直角三角形，C 点在左下，A 点在左侧，B 点在下方偏右，AC 与 CB 垂直。以斜边 AB 为一边向三角形外侧作正方形 ABDE，正方形的对角线 AD 和 EB 相交于 O，图中还连接了 OC。推理：按指定辅助线作 OF 垂直 BC 于 F，再作 AM 垂直 OF 于 M。因为 AC 垂直 BC，且 OF 垂直 BC，所以 AC 平行 OF；又 AM 垂直 OF，所以 AM 平行 BC。因此四边形 ACFM 是矩形，得到 MF = AC = 3，且 AM = CF。由于 ABDE 是正方形，O 是正方形对角线交点，所以 OA = OB，且 ∠AOB = 90°。在直角三角形 AOM 与 OBF 中，∠AMO = ∠OFB = 90°；又由正方形对角线垂直关系可得 ∠BOF = ∠OAM，并且 OA = OB，所以 △AOM ≅ △OBF。因此 AM = OF，OM = BF。又 AM = CF，所以 OF = CF。因为 OF 垂直 BC，CF 在 BC 上，所以 ∠CFO = 90°，于是 △CFO 是等腰直角三角形。已知 OC = 4√2，则两条直角边 CF = OF = 4。又 MF = 3，所以 BF = OM = OF − MF = 4 − 3 = 1。于是 BC = CF + BF = 4 + 1 = 5。

method.CoT_answer_check_final: 图像描述：附图中，ABC 是一个直角三角形，C 点在左下，A 点在左侧，B 点在下方偏右，AC 与 CB 垂直。以斜边 AB 为一边向三角形外侧作正方形 ABDE，正方形的对角线 AD 和 EB 相交于 O，图中还连接了 OC。推理：按指定辅助线作 OF 垂直 BC 于 F，再作 AM 垂直 OF 于 M。因为 AC 垂直 BC，且 OF 垂直 BC，所以 AC 平行 OF；又 AM 垂直 OF，所以 AM 平行 BC。因此四边形 ACFM 是矩形，得到 MF = AC = 3，且 AM = CF。由于 ABDE 是正方形，O 是正方形对角线交点，所以 OA = OB，且 ∠AOB = 90°。在直角三角形 AOM 与 OBF 中，∠AMO = ∠OFB = 90°；又由正方形对角线垂直关系可得 ∠BOF = ∠OAM，并且 OA = OB，所以 △AOM ≅ △OBF。因此 AM = OF，OM = BF。又 AM = CF，所以 OF = CF。因为 OF 垂直 BC，CF 在 BC 上，所以 ∠CFO = 90°，于是 △CFO 是等腰直角三角形。已知 OC = 4√2，则两条直角边 CF = OF = 4。又 MF = 3，所以 BF = OM = OF − MF = 4 − 3 = 1。于是 BC = CF + BF = 4 + 1 = 5。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$, a square $ABDE$ is constructed externally on the hypotenuse $AB$ of the triangle, and the diagonals of the square meet at point $O$. Line $OC$ is connected. Given that $AC=3$ and $OC=4\sqrt{2}$, what is the length of $BC$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, draw line $OF \perp BC$ at $F$, and draw line $AM \perp OF$ at $M$,\\
$\because$ $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AMO=\angle OFB=90^\circ$, $\angle ACB=\angle CFM=\angle AMF=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ quadrilateral $ACFM$ is a rectangle,\\
$\therefore$ $AM=CF$, $AC=MF=3$,\\
$\because$ quadrilateral $ABDE$ is a square,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOB=90^\circ$, $OA=OB$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOM+\angle BOF=90^\circ$,\\
Also $\because$ $\angle AMO=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle AOM+\angle OAM=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOF=\angle OAM$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle AOM \cong \triangle OBF$ (AAS),\\
$\therefore$ $AM=OF$, $OM=FB$,\\
$\therefore$ $OF=CF$,\\
$\because$ $\angle CFO=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle CFO$ is an isosceles right-angle triangle,\\
$\because$ $OC=4\sqrt{2}$,\\
By the Pythagorean theorem: $CF=OF=4$,\\
$\therefore$ $BF=OF-MF=4-3=1$,\\
$\therefore$ $BC=CF+BF=4+1=\boxed{5}$.

Image description: In the figure, C is at the lower left, A is directly above C, B is to the right of C, and triangle ABC is a right triangle at C; with hypotenuse AB as one side, square ABDE is constructed on the outside of the triangle, E is above and slightly to the right of A, D is at the upper right of B, the two diagonals AD and EB of the square intersect at O, and OC is connected.

Reasoning: According to the specified coordinate method, take C as the origin, BC along the positive direction of the x-axis, and AC along the positive direction of the y-axis. Since AC=3, A=(0,3). Let BC=b, then B=(b,0). Vector AB=B-A=(b,-3). From the figure it can be seen that the square is on the outside of AB, that is, on the side opposite to C, and side BD is the vector obtained by rotating AB counterclockwise by 90°, so BD=(3,b), therefore D=(b+3,b). O is the intersection point of the diagonals of the square, that is, the midpoint of AD, so O=((0+b+3)/2,(3+b)/2)=((b+3)/2,(b+3)/2). It is known that OC=4√2, and C=(0,0), so OC^2=((b+3)/2)^2+((b+3)/2)^2=32. That is, 2·((b+3)/2)^2=32, obtaining ((b+3)/2)^2=16. Since the length is positive, (b+3)/2=4, so b=5. Therefore BC=5.
